source.method: 逐篇对照本地原卷提取正文，核查字形及标点差异；逐句核对句块、语序和译文。

paragraphs.en: Europe is not a gender-equality heaven. In particular, the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly until women are part of senior management decisions, and Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male. Indeed, women hold only 14 per cent of positions on European corporate boards.

sentences.en: Europe is not a gender-equality heaven.

chunks.en: Europe is not a gender-equality heaven.
chunks.zh: 欧洲并非性别平等的天堂

sentences.translation: 欧洲并非性别平等的天堂。

sentences.en: In particular, the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly until women are part of senior management decisions, and Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male.

chunks.en: In particular,
chunks.zh: 尤其是

chunks.en: the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly

chunks.en: until women are part of senior management decisions,

chunks.en: and Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male.
chunks.zh: 而欧洲公司治理的最高层职位仍绝大多数由男性占据

sentences.reorder: 把 until 条件提前为“除非……否则……”，and 另说当前管理层状况。
sentences.translation: 尤其是，除非女性参与高层管理决策，否则企业职场绝不会完全有利于兼顾家庭，而欧洲公司治理的最高层职位仍绝大多数由男性占据。

sentences.en: Indeed, women hold only 14 per cent of positions on European corporate boards.

sentences.translation: 的确，女性仅占欧洲企业董事会席位的14%。

paragraphs.en: The European Union is now considering legislation to compel corporate boards to maintain a certain proportion of women – up to 60 per cent. This proposed mandate was born of frustration. Last year, European Commission Vice President Viviane Reding issued a call to voluntary action. Reding invited corporations to sign up for gender balance goals of 40 per cent female board membership. But her appeal was considered a failure: only 24 companies took it up.

sentences.en: The European Union is now considering legislation to compel corporate boards to maintain a certain proportion of women – up to 60 per cent.

sentences.translation: 欧盟如今正考虑立法，强制要求企业董事会保持一定比例、最高达60%的女性成员。

sentences.translation: 但她的呼吁被认为失败了：只有24家公司响应。

paragraphs.en: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?

sentences.en: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?

chunks.en: Do we need quotas
chunks.zh: 我们需要配额制度吗

chunks.en: to ensure

chunks.en: that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly

chunks.en: as they balance work and family?

sentences.reorder: 把目的和条件放到“需要配额吗”前，构成自然疑问句。
sentences.translation: 为了确保女性在兼顾工作与家庭时仍能公平地在企业中晋升，我们需要配额制度吗？

paragraphs.en: “Personally, I don't like quotas,” Reding said recently. “But I like what the quotas do.” Quotas get action: they “open the way to equality and they break through the glass ceiling,” according to Reding, a result seen in France and other countries with legally binding provisions on placing women in top business positions.

sentences.en: “Personally, I don't like quotas,” Reding said recently.

chunks.en: “Personally, I don't like quotas,”
chunks.zh: “就个人而言，我不喜欢配额，”

chunks.en: Reding said recently.
chunks.zh: 雷丁最近说

sentences.translation: 雷丁最近说：“就个人而言，我不喜欢配额。”

sentences.en: “But I like what the quotas do.”

chunks.en: “But I like what the quotas do.”
chunks.zh: “但我喜欢配额带来的效果。”

sentences.translation: 雷丁说，配额能促成行动，“开辟通往平等的道路，并打破玻璃天花板”；这一效果已经出现在法国等以法律约束力规定女性进入企业高层的国家。

phrases.meaning: 阻挡女性晋升高层的无形障碍

paragraphs.en: I understand Reding's reluctance – and her frustration. I don't like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable. But, when one considers the obstacles to achieving the meritocratic ideal, it does look as if a fairer world must be temporarily ordered.

sentences.en: I understand Reding's reluctance – and her frustration.

chunks.en: I understand Reding's reluctance

chunks.en: – and her frustration.

sentences.translation: 我理解雷丁的不情愿，也理解她的挫败感。

sentences.en: I don't like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable.

chunks.en: I don't like quotas either;

words.meaning: 按能力与业绩选拔的制度

sentences.translation: 但考虑到实现任人唯贤理想的种种障碍，似乎确实有必要暂时靠强制规定促成一个更公平的世界。

paragraphs.en: After all, four decades of evidence has now shown that corporations in Europe as well as the US are evading the meritocratic hiring and promotion of women to top positions – no matter how much “soft pressure” is put upon them. When women do break through to the summit of corporate power – as, for example, Sheryl Sandberg recently did at Facebook – they attract massive attention precisely because they remain the exception to the rule.

sentences.en: After all, four decades of evidence has now shown that corporations in Europe as well as the US are evading the meritocratic hiring and promotion of women to top positions – no matter how much “soft pressure” is put upon them.

chunks.en: are evading the meritocratic hiring and promotion of women to top positions

sentences.translation: 毕竟，四十年的证据已经表明，无论施加多少“软性压力”，欧洲和美国的企业都在回避按照能力聘用女性、把她们提拔到高层。

phrases.meaning: 非强制性的舆论或倡议压力

paragraphs.en: If appropriate public policies were in place to help all women – whether CEOs or their children's caregivers – and all families, Sandberg would be no more newsworthy than any other highly capable person living in a more just society.

sentences.en: If appropriate public policies were in place to help all women – whether CEOs or their children's caregivers – and all families, Sandberg would be no more newsworthy than any other highly capable person living in a more just society.

sentences.translation: 如果已有适当公共政策帮助所有女性及所有家庭——无论女性是首席执行官还是孩子的照料者——桑德伯格就不会比一个更加公正社会中的其他能力出众的人更有新闻价值。

phrases.meaning: 已经建立并有效运作的
